out.title: Ashish Chandra appointed Chief Manufacturing Officer (Designate)
out.summary: Ashish Chandra appointed Chief Manufacturing Officer (Designate) from 16 Sep 2026, taking full charge 1 Apr 2027; E R Raj Narayanan relinquishes on 31 Mar 2027 after transition.

person.name: Ashish Chandra
person.bio: ~33 years' manufacturing experience; leadership in large-scale operations, projects, transformation; developed India's first 980 MPa cold-rolled steel; 8 publications, 5 patents; Mechanical Engineer, Punjab Engineering College; Brown University leadership programme.
